methodology: Records are a selective, source-linked research sample. A sourced event is not necessarily an original post or a statement. Chart figures count one primary issue per record; social API data is not connected. Dates in press and official releases are generally source publication dates unless an original event timestamp is independently established; regional/division references must not be pinned to one district.
